entities.name: Brotherhood's End
entities.description: A spontaneous clash at Tocasia's Digsite between Urza and Mishra, each yearning for the other's powerstone.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother of Mishra, who fought him at Tocasia's Digsite; the Fallaji diggers would not follow him.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who fled after the clash; the Fallaji would have followed him.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Mentor of the brothers, killed in the explosion.

entities.name: Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Excavation camp where the brothers clashed.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Diggers who would have followed Mishra but not Urza.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Where the brothers found the two halves of the powerstone months earlier.

events.summary: Urza and Mishra fought with their powerstones, each yearning for the other's stone.
events.quote: The disagreement over who should wield both escalated into a fight

events.summary: An explosion from the uncontrolled stones killed Tocasia as she tried to intervene.
events.quote: a powerful explosion caused the death of Tocasia

events.summary: Mishra fled and the excavation camp fell apart.
events.quote: Mishra fled, and the excavation camp fell apart without Tocasia's influence.
